sn11.17:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti paṭisallīno || || 3.
sn11.17:1.3: Atha kho Sakko ca devānam indo Brahmā ca sahampati yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā paccekadvārabāhaṃ nissāya aṭṭhaṃsu || || 4.
sn11.17:1.4: Atha kho Sakko devānam indo Bhagavato santike imaṃ Gātham abhāsi || ||
sn11.17:3.1: Na kho devānam inda Tathāgatā evaṃ vanditabbā ||
sn11.17:3.2: evañ ca kho devānam inda Tathagatā vanditabbā || ||
